newsitem.title: USA: Melville CVS, Footaction same-sales surge.
newsitem.headline: Melville CVS, Footaction same-sales surge.

text.p: Melville Corp said Thursday that same-store sales for the five-week period ended October 5 were up 15.1 percent for its Footaction stores and up 13.5 percent for its CVS chain.
The company said same-store sales at its Linen 'n Things superstores were up 1.1 percent, and same-store sales at its Meldisco stores were up 2.9 percent.
Melville reported that the combined same-store sales for the four stores and its Thom McAn and Bob's stores were up 10.1 percent.
